description: This Swift source file defines a class MenuContextCardInjector that manages the injection of a custom context menu card into an NSMenu in a macOS application. It handles menu delegate methods, caching session data, and injecting SwiftUI views into menu items.

classes.name: MenuContextCardInjector
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for injecting a custom context card into a macOS menu, managing cache, and handling menu delegate interactions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the injector into the provided NSStatusItem, replacing its menu delegate if necessary and warming cache.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles preparations when the menu is about to open, injecting a custom view and starting cache refresh if needed.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the menu closes, cancelling ongoing cache refresh task.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Optional method to support delegate calls to update the menu if needed.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Provides the rectangle within which the menu is confined, delegating to original delegate if available.
